verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's core documented use case is scanning full git history (including deleted/unreachable commits) plus live repos for hardcoded secrets, with CLI examples (`trufflehog github --repo ...`, `--since-commit`) and verification of found secrets; this is corroborated by both official docs and GitHub README examples. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of full git-history depth/accuracy beyond vendor docs.
